items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:54:1
items.html: AVI: An immense bond was added in them, namely that they are attached together face to face at all times, in a single wall, etc.: For it was explained above (page 629, the passage beginning “And After”) that even the Gadlut of AVI also came out in the discernment of face to back, since the Bina of the Rosh does not leave her posterior upon Aba, except by the raising of MAN. See there. And these posterior are called a wall, as above — that by this wall AVI are attached together, in an immense bond, face to face. And although Ima receives only Hassadim, nevertheless, relative to themselves, these Hassadim are considered discernments of face to face, because Hochma is not lacking to them, since they are the discernment of GAR; and only Hassadim are lacking to Ima, in the secret of “for He desires mercy.” Hence the reception of the Hassadim from Aba is considered to her as the complete filling of her wholeness, and hence this coupling is considered the discernment of face to face, even though she receives from him only the light of Hassadim.
